title: 第九章 杀人杀到底送佛送到西第十章 夜袭仁义堂统统打死
slug: 修炼一天抵十年莫欺老年穷
lines: 林玄出了韩家老宅不远。
突然。
脚步停下，看向眼前区域。
连续三道人影从暗中一下窜出，将他团团围住。
全都身穿短打，身躯健硕，一个个眸光冰冷，太阳穴高高突起，气血异于常人，一看就知都是练武之辈。
“老头，沈七他们呢？”
一道平静淡漠的声音，突然从林玄的身后缓缓传出。
林玄侧头看去。
一位留着身穿精致西装，头戴黑色礼帽的青年男子，从一侧缓缓走来，手上还戴了一个玉扳指，取出白色丝巾，在擦拭着扳指，口中轻轻吹着热气。
“老头？”
林玄眉头皱起，道：“我比你爹年纪都大，你叫我什么？你该叫我爹！”
“你说什么？”
青年男子眼神一眯，眉头忍不住挑了挑，差点没忍住。
身边的其他三人全都脸色大怒。
“死老头你活腻了？”
“老东西，你他妈吃屎了？”
他们出声爆喝。
“别嚷嚷。”
青年语气一冷，制止住眼前三人，目光注视着陈玄，“老先生，去巷子聊会？”
他也担心在这里动手会引来清异局。
虽说新国刚立不久，人命案件并不少见。
但是一旦涉及到了武者，那清异局就如同闻到腥味的疯狗一样，飞快扑来。
“行，带路！”
林玄语气沙哑。
三人围着他走进巷子。
青年走在了最前方。
箱子深处，是个死胡同。
青年转过身来，脸上浮现出一抹森然笑容。
“自我介绍一下，我叫顾占鳌，仁义堂十三太保之一，还有个绰号，叫做‘白面阎王’，老先生，可以告诉我，沈七他们去哪了吗...”
嗖！
他话音刚没说完。
林玄已经动了。
顾占鳌只觉得眼前一花，然后胸口一疼。
他低头便发现，林玄的手掌已经陷入他的胸口，里面五脏六腑就跟变成了豆腐渣一样，瞬间粉碎，嘴巴长了张，想喊却又喊不出来。
血水、内脏碎片不断从从嘴中涌出。
他只能瞪大眼睛，满脸浓郁惊恐。
content_en:
Lin Xuan left the Han family's old house not far away.
Sudden.
He stopped and looked at the area in front of him.
Three figures in a row jumped out of the darkness and surrounded him.
They were all wearing shorts and had strong bodies. Their eyes were cold, their temples were bulging high, and their energy and blood were different from ordinary people. You could tell at a glance that they were all martial arts practitioners.
"Old man, where are Shen Qi and the others?"
A calm and indifferent voice suddenly came slowly from behind Lin Xuan.
Lin Xuan looked sideways.
A young man wearing an exquisite suit and a black top hat walked slowly from one side. He also wore a jade finger on his hand. He took out a white silk scarf and wiped the ring while gently blowing hot air from his mouth.
"Old man?"
Lin Xuan frowned and said, "I'm older than your father, what do you call me? You should call me dad!"
"What did you say?"
The young man's eyes narrowed and he couldn't help but raise his eyebrows. He almost couldn't help it.
The other three people around him all looked furious.
"Old man, are you tired of living?"
"Old man, did you fucking eat shit?"
They shouted loudly.
"Don't yell."
The young man's tone was cold, he stopped the three people in front of him, and looked at Chen Xuan, "Old sir, are you going to have a chat in the alley?"
He was also worried that taking action here would lead to trouble.
Although the new country was just founded, human life cases are not uncommon.
But once a warrior is involved, the Qingyi Bureau will pounce on them like a mad dog that smells fishy smell.
"Okay, lead the way!"
Lin Xuan's tone was hoarse.
The three of them walked into the alley around him.
The young man walked at the forefront.
Deep inside the box is a dead end.
The young man turned around with a stern smile on his face.
"Let me introduce myself. My name is Gu Zhan'ao, one of the Thirteen Taibao of Renyi Hall. I also have a nickname, 'White-faced King of Hell'. Old sir, can you tell me where Shen Qi and the others have gone..."
Whoosh!
He had just finished speaking.
Lin Xuan has already moved.
Bang! ! !
Gu Zhan'ao felt his eyes blur, and then his chest hurt.
He lowered his head and found that Lin Xuan's palm had sunk into his chest, and the internal organs inside were as if they had turned into tofu dregs, shattering instantly. His mouth was opened, and he wanted to shout but couldn't.
Blood, water and internal organs continued to pour out of his mouth.
He could only stare wide-eyed, his face full of horror.
title_en: Chapter 9: Kill until the end and send the Buddha to the West. Chapter 10: Attack Renyi Hall at night and kill them all.
